hypothesis: A 64-bit 0/1 local bypasses early integer if-conversion; only its low half remains at the int call boundary. A volatile comparison read constrains scheduling of that expression without adding any memory accesses. Qualifying only field22 preserves the retail mr/lwz order; qualifying both reads swaps those two instructions. These are equivalent C reconstruction choices, not proof of the original source types.
baseline: Accepted base source equals preserved commit 2e60f928 source (SHA-1 8008bbe14abd4cf80ef36fa6a1ac2076394d621f); inherited @9 externalization was already present. Baseline strict score 94.01923, 204 generated bytes versus 208 target bytes.
normalization: Each experimental object used the existing audited bias externalization mechanism, selecting its emitted local symbol from nm. The final source emits @10; only this function registration is updated accordingly. Compiler flags remain canonical GC/1.3.
